meta.title: My habits — Friends with Habits
meta.description: Check in on your habits, see your streak and join open pacts from any browser.

common.networkError: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
common.genericError: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
common.noscript: The web app needs JavaScript. Turn it on, or use the Android app.

today.streakAtStake: Check in today to keep it alive.

habit.freezeUsedToast: Checked in. A streak freeze covered the day you missed.
habit.awaitingPartner: Invite sent. Waiting for your partner to accept.
habit.notFound: We could not find that habit on your account.
habit.appOnlyNote: Photo proof, pact chat and reminders are in the Android app. Everything you do here shows up there too.

invites.accepted: You are in. The pact has started.

discover.heading: Open pacts
discover.intro: These pacts are open to new people. Ask to join and the person who started it decides.
discover.empty: No open pacts right now. Start a habit below and invite a friend to it from the app.
discover.requestSentToast: Request sent. You will be added when it is approved.
discover.templatesIntro: Pick one to start tracking today. Your first habit can run on its own for a week before it needs a partner.
discover.startedToast: {habit} added. Check in whenever you are ready.

empty.title: No habits yet
empty.body: Join an open pact or start a habit, and your first check-in is one tap away.

share.heading: Habits stick with a friend
share.body: Send your invite link. When they join, you can pact up and keep each other on streak.
share.copied: Link copied. Send it to a friend.
share.shareTitle: Join me on Friends with Habits
share.shareText: Pact up with me on Friends with Habits and let's keep each other on streak.

getApp.heading: Get more in the app
getApp.body: Create pacts with friends, add photo proof, chat with your partner and get reminders.
getApp.iosBody: The iPhone app is on the way. Until then, everything on this page works right here in your browser.
